The '''Dentaal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]].
